blocks.title: Maintenance
blocks.text: Maintenance SDLC ka aakhri marhala hai: musalsal dekh bhaal aur updates yaqeeni banate hain ke software theek chalta rahe aur users ki zarooraton ya technology ki tabdeeliyon ke mutabiq dhalta rahe.
Maintenance paude ki dekh bhaal jaisa hai: use sehatmand aur barhta rakhne ke liye baqaidagi se pani dena aur masail hal karne parte hain.

blocks.prompt: Deploy hone ke baad bhi software par kaam kyun chahiye?
blocks.explanation: Users ki zarooratein aur technology badalti rehti hain aur naye masail aate hain, is liye software ko theek chalte rehne ke liye updates aur islah chahiye; yahi maintenance ka marhala hai.

items: Maintenance: SDLC ka aakhri marhala; musalsal updates aur islah ta ke software chalta rahe aur tabdeeli ke mutabiq dhale; paude ki dekh bhaal jaisa.
